<b>Voltvessels</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Red|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It can be used to throw a spear that generates a column of electricity, or thrown as a projectile that bounces before exploding in a circle of electricity.

== Usefulness ==
The Spear form of Voltvessels throws a stake diagonally downwards that deals damage upon hitting an enemy and, once embedded in a surface, creates a column of electricity in its place. This beam can hit an enemy up to 6 times. Once the Voltvessel has been embedded in a surface, the stake can be struck with the [[Needle]] to angle the beam of electricity diagonally. 

The Bola form throws a projectile that snaps apart on contact with a surface or enemy, turning into 2 bouncing orbs that both explode into a circular electric field after a few seconds which can each hit an enemy up to 4 times. These orbs can be hit with the Needle to redirect them.

Voltvessels can be changed between Spear and Bola form while resting on a [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]] by pressing [[Controls (Silksong)|ATTACK]] (SPRINT on keyboard) when the tool is selected in the inventory.

* If any electric fields hit a water source, Voltvessels will send out a wave of electricity across the entire surface of the water. This is useful for various water-based enemies, such as [[Groal the Great]], or filling out elusive [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entries such as [[Muckmaggot]].
** Voltvessels will activate on impact with a water source, bypassing the charge-up delay.

* The Voltvessels' electricity is not affected by [[Pollip Pouch]]; however, if the tool itself makes contact with an enemy, it will apply the [[Pollip Pouch]]'s poison effect. The tool has to be thrown into the enemy's hitbox to achieve this. {{MissingInfo}}

== How to Acquire ==
Found behind a breakable wall in the northeast of the [[Memorium]], guarded by 2 [[Memoria]] enemies.

== Trivia ==
* Voltvessels has a unique text prompt for trying to change its form without a bench: "Transform Tools while resting at a bench." It uses the same icon as trying to change Tools without a bench. 
* NPC allies, such as [[Shakra]], [[Garmond & Zaza]], and [[Second Sentinel]], are also able to hit the spear form of the Voltvessel to angle the beam of electricity produced. Similarly, [[Skarr Scout]] sickles are able to strike the Voltvessel stake.
